items.source: Creates a new PropertyReferenceException.
items.translation: 创建一个新的PropertyReferenceException。

items.source: Returns the PropertyPath which could be resolved so far.
items.translation: 返回迄今为止可解析的PropertyPath。

items.source: Returns whether the given PropertyReferenceException has a deeper resolution depth (i.e. a longer path of already resolved properties) than the current exception.
items.translation: 判断给定的PropertyReferenceException的解析深度（即已解析属性的路径长度）是否大于当前异常。

items.source: Returns the name of the property not found.
items.translation: 返回未找到属性的名称。

items.source: Returns the type the property could not be found on.
items.translation: 返回该属性无法找到的类型。

items.source: Exception being thrown when creating PropertyPath instances.
items.translation: 创建PropertyPath实例时抛出异常。

items.source: getMessage in class Throwable
items.translation: getMessage 在类 Throwable 中

items.source: alreadyResolvedPath - the previously calculated PropertyPaths, must not be null.
items.translation: alreadyResolvedPath - 之前计算出的 PropertyPath，不能为 null。

items.source: propertyName - the name of the property not found on the given type, must not be null or empty.
items.translation: propertyName - 在给定类型中未找到的属性名称，不能为 null 或空。

items.source: type - the type the property could not be found on, must not be null.
items.translation: type - 无法在该类型上找到的属性，不能为 null。

items.source: Oliver Gierke, Christoph Strobl, John Blum
items.translation: 奥利弗·吉尔克，克里斯托夫·施特罗布，约翰·布鲁姆

items.source: will not be null or empty.
